promotion_boundary: This partial ledger is reconstruction infrastructure only. It does not support motive, culpability, truthfulness, legal, causation, or publication findings.

control_analysis.interpretation: The witness invoked the Fifth Amendment on three facially harmless baseline questions. Invocation on a substantive question therefore cannot, standing alone, discriminate among guilt, knowledge, motive, or exposure hypotheses.
control_analysis.inference_boundary: Harmless-question refusal does not prove that all refusals had the same subjective basis; it establishes only that refusal was not limited to exposure-bearing questions.
